section.catchline: Exemption from sales tax for cannabis.
section.subsection:
As used in this section:
"Cannabis" means the same as that term is defined in Section 26B-4-201. "Cannabis product" means the same as that term is defined in Section 26B-4-201. "Medical cannabis device" means the same as that term is defined in Section 26B-4-201. "Medical cannabis pharmacy" means the same as that term is defined in Section 26B-4-201. "Medicinal dosage form" means the same as that term is defined in Section 26B-4-201.

In addition to the exemptions described in Section 59-12-104, the sale by a licensed medical cannabis pharmacy of the following is not subject to the taxes this chapter imposes:
cannabis in a medicinal dosage form; or a cannabis product in a medicinal dosage form.
The sale of a medical cannabis device by a medical cannabis pharmacy is subject to the taxes this chapter imposes.
